# István Zoltán Szász — Junior Full-Stack Developer

> István Zoltán Szász (also written Istvan Zoltan Szasz) is a Junior Full-Stack Web Developer and Computer Science Engineer based in Érd, Hungary. He builds modern, responsive web applications with a strong specialisation in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and the modern JavaScript ecosystem. He holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science Engineering from Óbuda University (Alba Regia Faculty of Engineering), Székesfehérvár, Hungary, graduated February 2025.

## Professional Summary

István is a Junior Full-Stack Developer. He has developed full-stack applications through academic, certificate-based and independent projects, working across the entire stack from user interface to debugging and deployment. His frontend expertise centres around React and Next.js, while his backend work covers Node.js, Express.js, REST API design, and database management (SQL & NoSQL). He also works on mobile development with React Native and 3D development using Unreal Engine 5.
